title: Artificial Neural Network and Cox Regression Models for Predicting Mortality after Hip Fracture Surgery: A Population-Based Comparison.
summary: Retrospective population cohort of 10,534 hip-fracture procedures compares ANN with Cox regression; holdout test AUROC .93 vs .88 and sensitivity .96 vs .92 for mortality. External replication and prospective utility were not established.
